a.name: CFG flattening
a.why: merges nested branches into a single conditional block

a.name: code sinking
a.why: moves instructions down into conditional branches where used

a.name: DFA jump threading
a.why: threads state-machine switch jumps across loop iterations

a.name: guard widening
a.why: combines multiple runtime guards into a single wider check

a.name: hot/cold splitting
a.why: outlines cold basic blocks to improve instruction cache locality

a.name: inductive range check elimination
a.why: splits loops to eliminate bounds checks inside the main loop

a.name: instruction simplification
a.why: simplifies instructions without creating new ones

a.name: library call simplification
a.why: replaces known standard library calls with faster equivalents

a.name: loop bound splitting
a.why: splits loops at a conditional bound to simplify each half

a.name: loop versioning
a.why: clones a loop with a runtime aliasing check to enable optimization

a.name: n-ary reassociation
a.why: reassociates n-ary expressions to expose common subexpressions

a.name: scalarization
a.why: converts vector operations into scalar element operations

b.name: hot-cold splitting
b.why: outlines cold basic blocks into separate functions to improve icache locality

b.name: vector combining
b.why: optimizes sequences of vector shuffles, extracts, and inserts

b.name: critical edge splitting
b.why: inserts empty blocks on critical CFG edges to enable code motion

b.name: loop-closed SSA
b.why: inserts phi nodes at loop exits to simplify loop transformations
